acs.text: Creating a user with POST /Account/v1/User and a JSON body { "userName", "password" } whose password satisfies the policy returns 201 Created. The body contains the new user's id (userID, a UUID), username equal to the requested user name, and an empty books list.
outcomes: 201 Created
body contains `userID`, a UUID
body `username` equals the requested user name
body `books` is an empty list

acs.text: A password that does not satisfy the policy (too short, or missing an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit or a special character) is rejected with 400, error code "1300" and the message "Passwords must have at least one non alphanumeric character, one digit ('0'-'9'), one uppercase ('A'-'Z'), one lowercase ('a'-'z'), one special character and Password must be eight characters or longer." No account is created (a token cannot be obtained for it).
outcomes: each policy violation (too short; no uppercase letter; no lowercase letter; no digit; no special character) → 400
error `code` "1300"

message "Passwords must have at least one non alphanumeric character, one digit ('0'-'9'), one uppercase ('A'-'Z'), one lowercase ('a'-'z'), one special character and Password must be eight characters or longer."
no account is created: a token cannot be obtained for that user name and password

acs.text: Creating a user whose user name already exists is rejected with 406, error code "1204" and the message "User exists!".
outcomes: error `code` "1204"
message "User exists!"

acs.text: Creating a user without a user name or without a password is rejected with 400, error code "1200" and the message "UserName and Password required."
outcomes: without a user name → 400, error `code` "1200", message "UserName and Password required."
without a password → 400, error `code` "1200", message "UserName and Password required."

acs.text: POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken with the correct user name and password returns 200 with a non-empty token, status "Success", result "User authorized successfully." and an expires timestamp 7 days after the moment the token was issued.
outcomes: `token` is non-empty
`status` "Success"
`result` "User authorized successfully."
`expires` is a timestamp 7 days after the moment the token was issued

acs.text: POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken with a wrong password issues no token: token and expires are null, status is "Failed" and result is "User authorization failed."
outcomes: 401 Unauthorized (PO clarification, story.md#L75)
`token` is null
`expires` is null
`status` "Failed"
`result` "User authorization failed."

acs.text: The token must not disclose the user's password: decoding the token (a JWT) must not reveal the password in any part of it.
outcomes: the token decodes as a JWT
no part of the decoded token (header, payload, signature) contains the user's password

acs.text: POST /Account/v1/Authorized with { "userName", "password" } returns false for a newly created user who has not been issued a token yet, and true once a token has been generated for that user. With a wrong password it never returns true; it answers with the message "User not found!".
outcomes: newly created user, no token issued yet → `false`
after a token has been generated for that user → `true`
wrong password → never `true`
wrong password → message "User not found!"

acs.text: On the login page (/login), signing in with an account created through the API opens the profile page (/profile), which shows "User Name :" followed by that user's name. After this sign-in, POST /Account/v1/Authorized returns true for the account.
outcomes: after signing in, the profile page `/profile` is open
the profile page shows "User Name :" followed by the user's name
`POST /Account/v1/Authorized` then returns `true` for the account

acs.text: Signing in with a wrong password keeps the user on the login page and shows the message "Invalid username or password!" in red below the form.
outcomes: the user stays on the login page `/login`
message "Invalid username or password!" is shown below the form
the message is shown in red

acs.text: Clicking "Login" with an empty user name and an empty password does not sign in; both fields are highlighted as invalid.
outcomes: clicking "Login" with both fields empty does not sign in (the user stays on the login page)
the user name field is highlighted as invalid
the password field is highlighted as invalid

acs.text: Clicking "Logout" on the profile page signs the user out and returns to the login page. Opening /profile afterwards no longer shows the user name and shows "Currently you are not logged into the Book Store application, please visit the login page to enter or register page to register yourself."
outcomes: clicking "Logout" on the profile page returns to the login page
opening `/profile` afterwards does not show the user name
opening `/profile` afterwards shows "Currently you are not logged into the Book Store application, please visit the login page to enter or register page to register yourself."

acs.text: DELETE /Account/v1/User/{UUID}, authorized with the user's token, deletes the account and returns 204 No Content. Afterwards POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken for that user name returns status "Failed".
outcomes: DELETE with the user's token → 204 No Content
afterwards `POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken` for that user name returns `status` "Failed"

rules.text: Password policy: at least 8 characters, with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit and one special (non-alphanumeric) character; enforced when an account is created.

Accounts are created through the API (POST /Account/v1/User) with a unique user name per run (for example qa-<timestamp>) and removed afterwards with DELETE /Account/v1/User/{UUID}. Accounts for sign-in are always created through the API.
The password for these accounts is taken from the environment variable DQ_USER_PASSWORD (it satisfies the password policy). Never hard-code a password.

errorModel.body: code "1300", message "Passwords must have at least one non alphanumeric character, one digit ('0'-'9'), one uppercase ('A'-'Z'), one lowercase ('a'-'z'), one special character and Password must be eight characters or longer."

errorModel.case: creating a user whose user name already exists
creating a user without a user name or without a password
GenerateToken with a wrong password or an unknown user name
errorModel.body: token null, expires null, status "Failed", result "User authorization failed."

oracleGaps.value: 401 Unauthorized for GenerateToken with a wrong password or an unknown user name; body as in AC-6. AC-8 (Authorized) is unchanged. AC-13's outcome stays as written (status "Failed"); the 401 from L75 also applies to that request since the deleted user name is unknown

the issue moment is taken as the time the GenerateToken request was sent/answered; `expires` (parsed as an ISO-8601 timestamp, UTC if no offset is given) must be 7 days after that moment, allowing only for clock difference between test client and server (a tolerance of a few minutes, not hours)
no specific status is asserted; the check is that the response is not `true` and carries the message "User not found!"
"without" covers both the field being absent and the field being an empty string; each must give 400 / code "1200" / "UserName and Password required."

"in red": the message text's rendered colour is a red hue (red channel clearly dominant); "highlighted as invalid": each empty field is visibly marked invalid by the page (e.g. an invalid-state style or indicator on that field) after clicking "Login"
